memory_ablation_contract.expected_after_ablation: MEM_ABL_A and MEM_ABL_B provider inputs identical except the residual Affect difference and its hash binding
memory_ablation_contract.projection_identity: recomputed over the ablated body via cognitiveProjectionHash
memory_ablation_contract.removed: factual_memory_evidence entries of kind BEHAVIOR_OUTCOME (the only kind the lives produce)
memory_ablation_contract.surface: future cognition provider-facing V2 projection (experimental provider wrapper)

metric_contract.ablation_control_invalid_if: machine input-equality check fails, OR ablation pair behavior disagreement exceeds the treatment pair disagreement AND is >= 0.40
metric_contract.arm_failure_rate: #(trials of the arm without a valid behavior)/TRIALS_PER_ARM
metric_contract.behavior_delta: primary treatment pair disagreement − primary ablation pair disagreement
metric_contract.behavior_unit: one trial ordinal in which all four arms produced a behavior with nonempty text (cognition VALID or DIRECTIVE_CLARIFY)
metric_contract.future_affect_classification: EFFECTIVELY_EQUAL (<1e-9 residual valence delta) / NEGLIGIBLE_BUT_NONZERO (<0.001) / MATERIAL_CONFOUND (>=0.001)
metric_contract.intent_delta: primary treatment pair intent mismatch − primary ablation pair intent mismatch
metric_contract.intent_mismatch_rate: over complete units: #(paired trials whose cognition current_intent strings differ, null counting as the string "null")/#complete units
metric_contract.pair_disagreement_rate: over complete units: #(paired trials whose behavior text differs)/#complete units
